about.title: About the platform
about.lead: HyDroMa Nojin is an integrated platform for landscape restoration: from data and scientific models to markets, carbon and rural livelihoods.
about.what: The platform records land and landscape as a data profile, analyses it with documented scientific models (FAO-56, RUSLE, Richards, Saint-Venant) and returns results with an uncertainty range and explicit provenance.
about.audience: Farmers, pastoralists, cooperatives and local markets, public institutions, researchers and investors.
evidence: Real data from the platform database and services
Explicit source and date label on every number
limits: Heavy computation depends on the C++ core, which is unavailable in this environment
Field data is limited until the pilot begins
next: Fully connect the scientific tools to real data

services.title: Services and solutions
services.lead: Practical starting points for pilots, field learning and data-informed decisions.
services.what: Each solution begins with a real problem, names the data and model it needs, and returns a result with explicit limits and provenance.
services.audience: Farmers, cooperatives, water and soil managers, researchers and delivery teams.
evidence: A recorded model version and analysis date
limits: Every solution needs validated data and local calibration
A pilot result is not final without field review
next: Capture user feedback and revise the model

evidence.title: Science and evidence
evidence.lead: Every scientific claim is shown with its source, validation method and limitations.
evidence.what: The evidence library links standard FAO and IPCC methods and scientific tool outputs to traceable decisions.
evidence.audience: Researchers, advisers and users who need an explanation and a reference.
limits: Not every model is valid in every climate
Field data quality remains the primary limitation

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.lead: Traceable answers for water, soil and livelihood questions.
ai.what: The assistant can prepare a calculation, but its final answer always needs a source and human confirmation.
evidence: A source is shown for every answer
Draft label for answers without a source
limits: A language model does not replace local judgement
Sensitive data must not be sent without permission

trust.title: Trust and provenance
trust.lead: Every datum can be traced to its service, retrieval time and validation method.
trust.what: The provenance explorer shows the data chain and distinguishes live data, demos and unavailable services.
trust.audience: Organisational users, auditors and scientific teams.
limits: Not all services have the same timestamp contract yet

developers.title: Developers
developers.lead: APIs, data contracts and integration tools for dependable services.
developers.what: OpenAPI documentation and a generated client provide a clear path to connect platform services.
developers.audience: Software teams, researchers and technology partners.
limits: Rate limits and authentication must be respected

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.lead: An experience usable with keyboards, screen readers, right-to-left and left-to-right languages.
accessibility.what: Semantic controls, Tab navigation, sufficient contrast and translatable messages are part of the base design.
accessibility.audience: Everyone, especially people with diverse access needs.
evidence: Direction and language checks in browsers
limits: Some specialist content still needs human review

statements.missionBody: Restore landscapes through data, science and community participation.
statements.transparencyBody: Data, model and limitations must be disclosed with every result.
